title: Index the ten review rounds published after the #1094 selection
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Navigation fix only; no construction, proof, certificate or κ change.

`README.md` and `docs/research/current-status.md` both stop at the `batch1099` review. The ten integration rounds published after the #1094 selection (`community-efficient100` … `community-efficient1000`, PRs through #2027, κ unchanged) are reachable only from `autoresearch.md`, the bottleneck brief and the priority log. A reader starting at the README or status page cannot tell that roughly 900 later PRs were reviewed.

- `current-status.md`: inside the current section (above the historical banner), a short **Reviews since the #1094 selection** paragraph and a table of the ten rounds with their frozen PR selections and merged/pending counts, copied from each review's header.
- `README.md`: a short pointer under the selected-result links to the review through #2027 and to that table.

No frozen review, receipt or historical section is edited.

## Task and overlap

- Task: `scope-navigation` (track `consolidation`, scope key `b18e0e173a4430a9564b`, seed `4bde80ee48fd3e1474e27b2d419a41ed`, catalogue revision 4). Scope unchanged.
- Base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (= `origin/main` at submission).
- Overlap: `find_overlap.py --refresh` timed out locally, so I checked open PRs touching `README.md` / `current-status.md` directly. #2214 (CI guidance in `docs/ci-verification.md`), #2411 (Lean pointer in README) and #2493 (overlap-helper README section) edit different sections; none indexes the post-#1094 rounds.
- I confirmed from git history that all ten review files were added after `community-batch1099-review.md`.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py   # PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY
python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_research_current_status tests.test_research_onboarding tests.test_research_replay_selection   # 35 tests OK
```

- A first draft used a `##` heading, which `test_history_banner_precedes_historical_sections` correctly rejected (it would end the current section before the banner). The final version uses a bold lead-in instead.
- All relative links in the two edited files resolve to existing files.
- Not run: full replays (documentation-only change) and hosted CI.

## Credit

The indexed reviews and every contribution they record belong to their original authors and reviewers. Substantial AI assistance: the task was selected, investigated and written with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), then reviewed and submitted by me.

## Open next questions

None justified for this change. Possible small follow-up: `CONTRIBUTING.md` still points pending-work readers to `contribution-review.md`, which is an Oct-8 historical triage index; it could point to the latest efficient review or the PR ledger instead.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

`scripts/find_overlap.py --refresh` did not finish within 120 s here; #2493's batched discussion reads may address this.
